title: Commons contributions now come back from the repository objects they cite
statement: In the merged multi-entry Commons (main b1af012) the repository navigator linked source objects only to imported problem records; a participant's contribution citing issue/99 was not visible to anyone browsing issue/99, search could not find it by the cited object, and no entrance was recorded. On branch blackmath88/nuc-20261031-commons the navigator joins visible contributions' source refs to docs, threads and comments across HTTP, CLI, MCP and the browser, each contribution carries an adapter-declared entrance, and search matches cited objects and returns source refs. Verified by tests and a live CLI smoke; isolated-PDS roundtrip only, not public federation; UI not browser-walked in this window.
conditions: Self-reviewed by the implementing assistant; no independent or human review.
Entrance is declared by the adapter (browser and CLI over HTTP, MCP server-side); it is not detection or authorization.
ATProto evidence is an isolated in-process PDS, not public federation.
Browser UI changes typechecked and built only.
